empty.no_traffic.paused: Capture is paused. Nothing is being recorded until you resume.

field.name: Name
response_truncated: Only the first 512 KB of the response is kept.
no_body.title: No body
create_flow_tooltip: Save the ticked exchanges as requests and chain them into a flow, in the order they were captured. Tick two or more.

saved_flow: Saved {count} requests to “{folder}” and built a flow from them.
import.title: Credentials and cookies found
import.secrets_body: These values look like credentials. Choose where they go: sealed in a vault, which only opens with its passphrase; into variables of the selected environment, which are synced with the workspace; or left written in the requests.
import.cookies_body: These requests carried cookies. The cookie jar is never synced, and a request gets its cookies from it when it is sent.
import.jar: Move them into the cookie jar
import.kept: Too short for a vault, left in the requests: {names}
stream.empty_live: Messages the client and the server exchange appear here.
stream.empty_closed: The stream closed without a message.
logs.empty.title: No log lines for this request
logs.empty.no_servers: No dev server is running. Start one on the Services screen to see what it prints for a request.
logs.empty.not_traced: Tracing is off for this request: it carries no trace id, so lines can only be matched by time and path.
logs.empty.none: No line of the dev servers' output carries this request's trace id.
pin_tooltip: Keep this exchange beyond the capture limit
unpin_tooltip: Let this exchange age out with the others
